run_superresolution_pipeline: run the IFSuperResolutionPipeline to upscale a low resolution image to high resolution using a text prompt
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings for use with the IF super resolution pipeline
preprocess_input_image: preprocess a PIL image or numpy array into a normalized torch tensor for the super resolution UNet
run_safety_checker: run the IFSafetyChecker on generated images to detect NSFW or watermarked content
clean_caption_text: clean and preprocess a caption string by removing URLs, HTML tags, CJK characters, and bad punctuation
